cohort: Women who gave birth between March 2020 and September 2020, compared to a matched historical cohort from 2017-2019
finding: Despite a shorter length of stay after delivery during the COVID-19 pandemic, there was no significant difference in rates of readmissions 30 days postpartum.
mod_finding: The study found that postpartum length of stay after both vaginal and cesarean delivery was shorter during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to a pre-pandemic control group.
